paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.03% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+4.51%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-7.13%). Brent crude changed -10.17% to 94.12. Gold changed +4.02% to 4,129.1001. Bitcoin changed -7.16% to 74,650.2266. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.859%, a relative move of -1.42%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (-13.87%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+13.63%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Monzo explores fundraising at £7.5bn valuation as private equity talks stall (FT Markets). Lender had shifted focus to talks with buyout groups after failing to clinch a £10bn takeover by Brazilian fintech Nubank Deals and capital markets: Private equity firm seeks to take control of LIV Golf from Saudi wealth fund (FT Markets). BC Partners looks to purchase Public Investment Fund’s bankruptcy loan in order to revive failed golf league assets Central banks and macro: Three ways the interest rate rise could affect you (BBC Business). Job, loans and savings are all affected by the rise in interest rates announced by the Bank of England. Central banks and macro: Bank rate rise ‘puts tracker mortgage trend at risk’ (FT World). Most fixed-rate borrowers are cushioned from the impact of this week’s decision but those coming off a five-year deal face a payment shock
